name: eval-history-initialization-detection
goal: Independently assess whether current history initialization satisfies the criteria. This is a source-only detection probe: no behavioral checks have been run for this candidate and missing execution alone is not the finding measured. Identify concrete defects without repairing them. Work only from current apple/Sources/TextbookCore/HistoryStore.swift, relevant textbook/answer definitions in Textbook.swift, and existing HistoryStoreTests.swift and HistoryInitializationIndependentRegressionTests.swift. Do not inspect Git history, other checkouts, prior solutions or parent chats. Do not delegate or run builds/tests. Host checks provide execution evidence. This is an isolated fixed evaluation, not permission to publish or merge.
acceptance: Independent simultaneous first opens of the same empty history database both succeed and can save/read each other's answers; reopening preserves schema and answer data.
If another connection commits a future version before the initializer acquires its write lock, reject it as unsupportedSchema with the committed version without changing schema, rows or user_version.
If another connection creates an unknown unversioned schema before lock acquisition, reject it without adopting or mutating that database.
Preserve corruption refusal, rollback and connection cleanup, answer validation, immutable textbook/question version association, and duplicate/conflicting-answer behavior.
Only apple/Sources/TextbookCore/HistoryStore.swift may be edited during repair; tests, other product sources, metadata, task/check controls and documentation are immutable.
The fixed full Swift suite must pass before repaired source can qualify for product acceptance. Review-only probes without execution are detection measurements, never product acceptance.
